actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The project calls itself an RSR (Real-to-Sim-to-Real) reinforcement-learning framework built on MuJoCo MJX and Brax
The two experimental platforms are an Airbot Play arm and a Unitree Go2 quadruped trained for flat/rough terrain joystick control
Go2 training scripts need PYTHONPATH=ppo_train/go2_training and the Go2 assets are bundled under mujoco_playground/_src/locomotion/go2/xmls
The card's entry Joystick is the Go2 joystick task and its default task is flat_terrain
The registry's Go2JoystickFlatTerrain entry is Joystick with task=flat_terrain
task_to_xml maps flat_terrain to scene_mjx_feetonly_flat_terrain.xml and rough_terrain to scene_mjx_feetonly_rough_terrain.xml
The served scene is the MuJoCo model 'go2 feetonly flat terrain scene' and it includes go2_mjx_feetonly.xml
The model compiler declares radian angles, a mesh directory, and autolimits enabled
The model integrates with Euler at a 0.004 s timestep
The go2 default class gives its position actuators inheritrange 1 and forcerange -24 to 24; the knee class overrides the force range to -35.55 to 35.55
The abduction joints have range -1.0472 to 1.0472 rad, the hip (thigh) joints -1.5708 to 3.4907 rad and the knee (calf) joints -2.7227 to -0.83776 rad
The actuator block declares twelve position actuators, one per Go2 leg joint: four abduction (hip), four hip (thigh) and four knee (calf) channels
Joystick initializes _init_q and _default_pose from the home keyframe's qpos
Joystick.reset starts from _init_q, then draws a base x/y offset from -0.5 to 0.5, a yaw from -3.14 to 3.14 rad and a base velocity from -0.5 to 0.5
The joystick default config sets action_scale 0.5, ctrl_dt 0.02 s and sim_dt 0.004 s
Joystick.step selects actual_action from the delay buffer when enabled, otherwise from the input, and sets motor_targets to _default_pose plus actual_action times action_scale
The joystick episode terminates when the IMU up vector's vertical component falls below zero
The scene's home keyframe sets the nominal qpos and ctrl of the standing pose

determinism.notes: The fake is a deterministic placeholder integrator, but no trajectory was compared with MuJoCo or with the upstream MJX environment and the bridge's reset takes no seed (it restores the model defaults), so no seed controls a trajectory. The bridge derives no determinism claim.

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the scene and its include for the joint layout, the actuator control ranges inherited from the joint ranges and the 4 ms option timestep, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated hinge; it loads no mesh or texture and resolves no contact, friction, gravity, inertia, actuator force, sensor or constraint

the served device is the raw MJCF scene, not the Joystick MjxEnv: the environment's normalized action (home pose + action_scale * action), command sampling, reward terms, observation vector, delay buffers, domain randomization and fall termination are not exposed by the MuJoCo family

the bridge resets with mj_resetData to the model defaults, while Joystick.reset starts from the home keyframe and randomizes the base x/y, yaw and velocity; this driver does not reproduce the environment reset
the environment advances 0.02 s of control time per action (ctrl_dt) in 0.004 s simulation steps (sim_dt); the bridge advances only the model's 0.004 s step per tick

MuJoCo, mujoco-mjx and jax are not installed where the gate ran and cannot be installed there (no network, no pip); no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine or the upstream environment, and the sim backend was not run
only the card's models[1] flat-terrain scene is served; the bowl, rough-terrain, stairs and full-collision scenes are other models and are not part of this driver
no physical Unitree Go2 is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Simulated time since the last reset
measures.name: time_ms

measures.description: Control vector last applied to the actuators (ctrl)
measures.name: ctrl

measures.description: Integration steps since the last reset
measures.name: tick

measures.description: Integration step of the model (null when the model states none)
measures.name: timestep_ms

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
